incidents.name: MEV bot 0xDd7c2987 forged CREATE2 pair callback
incidents.notes: The bot authenticated its swap callback by checking the caller against a CREATE2 address derived from a factory address, token pair and init-code hash all supplied in the call data, so the attacker deployed a contract at a matching derived address and used the callback to move the operator's WETH, USDT and USDC allowances to themselves.

sources.ref: onchain review: bot 0xDd7c2987686B21f656F036458C874D154A923685 created 2024-07-21T11:01:23Z by 0x0000000000e715268e0fe41ced1dd101fc696355 (the operator address whose balances were drained), not the attack-tx sender 0x98250d30aed204e5cbb8fef7f099bc68dbc4b896; no EIP-1967 events, 1.86 days old. Loss reported ~18k USD across WETH, USDT and USDC.
